sections.heading: Where it appears
lines: Natural battles in Mushroom Fields.

sections.heading: Type power
lines: Dragon moves are 2× stronger.
Steel moves, fairy moves, and slicing moves are 1.5× stronger.
Magic Powder also counts as Fairy for type matchups.
Fire moves also count as Dragon for type matchups.

sections.heading: Move effects
lines: Draining Kiss and Mist Ball: 2× stronger.

Ancient Power, Armor Cannon, Behemoth Bash, Eerie Spell, Fleur Cannon, Magical Leaf, Menacing Moonraze Maelstrom, Moongeist Beam, Mystical Fire, Oceanic Operetta, Relic Song, Smart Strike, and Sparkling Aria: 1.5× stronger.

sections.heading: Standard moves and typing
lines: Mimicry and Camouflage turn Pokémon Fairy-type.
Nature Power becomes Secret Sword.
Secret Power can cause sleep.

sections.heading: Abilities
lines: Armor Tail, Battle Armor, or Shell Armor: Defense +1 when it enters.
Magic Bounce, Magic Guard, or Pastel Veil: Special Defense +1 when it enters.
Magician: Special Attack +1 when it enters.
Marvel Scale: 1.5× Defense.
Mirror Armor: Special Defense +1 when it enters.
Power of Alchemy: Defense +1 and Special Defense +1 when it enters.
Queenly Majesty: 1.5× damage.
Stance Change: Defense +1 when it enters.

sections.heading: Seed
lines: Magical Seed: is shielded as by King's Shield.

sections.heading: More
lines: Rarer interactions of specific moves, abilities and items follow the Rejuvenation field rules and are not all listed here.
